title: Stores for the Hut

intro.speaker: silas
intro.text: The pack mule brought supplies up from the valley this morning. Everything's in a muddle!

intro.speaker: silas
intro.text: Here's my list for the hut. Would you read it, and put just what it says on the shelf?

steps.speaker: silas
steps.prompt: Read the list. Put the right things on the shelf, then press Done.

older.prompt: Read the list: no pictures this time. Put the right things on the shelf, then press Done.

feedback.all_good: Just what the list says! Enough to last till the shearing.

outro.speaker: silas
outro.text: A full shelf! A shepherd can't pop down to the shop. Thank you, friend.

journal_line: I read Mr. Silas's list and stocked the shepherd's hut.
